caption: A glass bottle falls onto a hard tile floor, breaks on impact, and its fragments remain scattered.

clauses.text: The glass bottle must be positioned on the edge of the shelf to ensure it can fall.
The bottle must be released or allowed to fall naturally to initiate the breakage.
The bottle must shatter upon impact with the hard tile floor, producing visible fragments.
The fragments must remain scattered on the floor after the impact, without being cleaned or moved.
